node.title: Re^2: Reading a hash structure stored in a file
node.author: johngg
node.doctext:
It's interesting to see that [mod://JSON::PP] is now the Perl core but I wonder why it doesn't seem to be listed as a core module on [http://perldoc.perl.org]. I wonder if there are other useful modules that are now core but have been omitted from the documentation.

Cheers,

JohnGG
